notes.title: New Map Coming March 21st – Barny's Playground Chapter 2!
notes.content:
Attention, anomaly hunters! 

We’ve got some exciting news for you. A brand-new map is coming to The Anomaly Project next week on Friday, March 21st! This update marks the second chapter of Barny's Party, continuing the eerie and thrilling story that has kept players on the edge of their seats.

What’s in store?

 A continuation of Barny's Party – Dive deeper into the terrifying story with a brand-new chapter.
 Classic Barny's Party gameplay – Experience the same intense and unpredictable style that players loved.
 Barny returns – More frights, more challenges, and more ways for Barny to keep you on your toes.
 New hedge maze area – A twisting labyrinth filled with lurking anomalies waiting in the shadows.

Thank You for Your Support!
We want to take a moment to thank all of you for your continued support. Your feedback, excitement, and dedication mean the world to us, and we can’t wait to see you jump into this terrifying new experience.

Mark Your Calendars!

 Release Date: Friday, March 21st
 Prepare for: More scares, more suspense, and an unforgettable horror experience.


Stay alert. Stay together. And most importantly… don’t let Barny catch you.

See you in the maze!

The Developer

notes.title: Changes coming this month
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're hard at work creating new content and cool new experiences and we'd like to share with you what we are working on.

New Maps
This month we will be releasing new maps!

These maps will be more in line with the quality and style of 'Floor 4', our first map.

According to the feedback we have received, you enjoyed Floor 4 a lot.
It has a good balance between proper actual anomalies, a good map size that is not too big nor too small, a good challenge and it has a slight fright/tension to it.

Overall Floor 4 sets the basis for what the direction of future maps will go in.

For those of you who do like the easier maps that are more scary/jumpscare focused, we have the Barny the Clown series that will continue to be available. 
We will move the entrance to its own dedicated location in the Lobby. 
This way we have a good distinction between more traditional 'Floor 4' styled maps, and scarier jumpscare focused maps.

The 'Stairs' map has not been enjoyed by a lot of people, so we're moving that to the dedicated 'shitty map' section somewhere in the Lobby. 


Summary

 New levels are in the works, and will be releasing this month.
 We are actively listening to your feedback and adding more of what you like.


Thanks guys,

The Developer

notes.title: Item shop, Plinko and Player Customization is now added!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

A new update is live! 

In this update we have added:

Store
Plinko
Player Customization

The item shop in the lobby currently offers 3 fun outfits for you to wear and show off to your friends.

People have been asking for the option to select your own pants color on the default character, so you can now head over to the customization area in the item shop and select your own pants color or equip one of your purchased outfits.

Not only can you select an outfit, you can also equip custom Magnifiers. So you can look even cooler when zooming in!

You can inspect your character in front of the camera on the wall and view yourself in third person to have a better look at your outfit.

We also added Plinko! So while you're chilling in the lobby with your friends you can test your luck and try and get the highest score.

Check out the GIFs below or head on over to the Item shop in-game and see for yourself!

Cheers,

notes.title: Barny's Party (New map) | Progress update
notes.content:
Hey guys,

Lead developer here with a little update on the Barny's Party map.

We're making great progress and are nearing the release of Barny's Party. For me personally this is our most anticipated map yet. We've put in loads of effort already to make it a fun, tense and scary. 

The focus of this map is on the constant tension that we aim to introduce here. This map needs to be one of our horror themed maps. It needs to make you suspicious and cautious of your environment all the time. I'm sure that Barny himself will help you guys with that a lot too : ).

The map is rather large and includes loads of cool sections such as a miniature kids playhouse area, a kids mini swimming pool area, Barny's playground, a river ride with boats, a scary maze and more.

Can't wait to have it finished and to release it to you guys! Thanks for all the support!

After this map releases we aim to introduce our brand new game-mode which I'll tell you more about then.

If all goes according to plan this map will release before end of the month! With this update we also release our item shop located in the lobby, with fun outfits/cosmetics and character customization.

Cheers,

The developer

notes.title: Feedback and Suggestions, round 1
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Developer here, I would like to know what you guys would like us to work on next. We've had various feedback now here and there, and additionally to that I'd like to ask you guys also what you think should be added or changed next in the game.

Here is a list of feedback we've had so far that we're working / thinking of adding in the game:


- We got some comments about adding the ability to die in the game. This way there is more than one way of getting reset back to zero. And it generally would add more suspense to the game.

- We also aim to change the general workings of the anomaly spawning. We want a more controlled way to guarantee that each run at least has easy, challenging and scary anomalies. Opposed to right now, where the anomaly is simply randomly chosen out of all available anomalies the level contains, and the anomaly appearance chance rate.

- More general suspension in the way of dangerous AI's that can chase / kill players, more dramatic anomalies, more big time environmental changes.

- Another point of feedback has been the request of Puzzles. We recently worked on adding interactivity to the game, now we simply just have to implement a way of using it by for example the implementation of puzzles. So if you guys have good suggestions for puzzles, please let me know down below in the comments.


That's pretty much it guys.

Please let me know your thoughts and feedback on the above and on the game in general so that we can improve it and make it an overall more enjoyable game! No suggestion is too wild, so just let us know your thoughts.

Appreciate all the support so far and glad to see so many players enjoying it.

Greetings,

The Developer
